body.name: published unrestricted \(p=2\) raw interval and this note's \(K\) restriction
body.construction: Watson et al. (2024, Corollary 2.1 and Appendix A.7) establish, for the scalar \(L_2\) leakage model with \(p=2\) and an unrestricted scalar effect domain, that the raw sharp set is empty when \(\delta(P)<0\) and is the interval \([\theta_-(P),\theta_+(P)]\) when \(\delta(P)\geq0\). This note separately restricts the effect parameter to \(K\), so its target is \(\Theta_I(P)=\{\theta\in K:q_P(\theta)\leq0\}\): it is empty when \(\delta(P)<0\), and it equals \(K\cap[\theta_-(P),\theta_+(P)]\) when \(\delta(P)\geq0\). The unrestricted raw interval is the published input; intersection with \(K\) is this note's parameter-space restriction.
